name: Enterprise Fund Committee Meeting Agenda for April 10, 2024
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE

  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA FOR THE
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  April 10, 2024 - 6:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall West - Conference Room A
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Meeting Minutes of January 17, 2024

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS
  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.
  A) Sewer Rate Study Report Presentation & Discussion (Raftelis) - Update
  B) Water Department Rate Study - Update
  C) Staff Update
  D) Operations Update
  E) Water Department - Purchase of 100 AMI Meters Discussion

7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted on April 4, 2024 at 4:40 p.m.
